policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Manage policies by owning extension and their current published versions.

editor.description: Validate a JSON Rule DSL draft before publishing an immutable revision.
editor.description_placeholder: Describe the business purpose of this policy.
editor.definition_placeholder: Enter a JSON Rule DSL definition.
editor.definition_hint: Only registered fields and supported operators are accepted; structure is validated before publication.
editor.json_valid: The JSON syntax is valid. Policy rule validity requires separate validation.
editor.empty_membership_error: Empty in/not_in lists are not allowed.
editor.ambiguous_empty_array_error: Empty arrays are not allowed in array comparison values.
editor.unverified_array_shape_error: The original JSON shape of the array comparison cannot be verified, so it cannot be published.
editor.schema_not_ready_error: The storage schema is not ready, so publishing is unavailable.
editor.validation_error_fallback: Some validation errors do not have an explanation. Check the error codes and paths in the diagnostic details below.

diff.title: Policy Change Comparison
diff.description: Compare structural changes between the published revision, prior revisions, and the current draft.
diff.integrity_verified: The stored Revision definition hash was verified.
diff.integrity_not_applicable: Drafts are not subject to Revision hash verification.
diff.safety_safe: No empty membership or ambiguous empty-array comparisons were found by the current checks.
diff.safety_unsafe: A condition that blocks safe evaluation was found.
diff.safety_unsafe_reason: Any unsafe condition blocks evaluation of the entire policy.
diff.safety_empty_membership: An empty in/not_in condition blocks evaluation of a published Revision and prevents a Draft from being published.
diff.safety_ambiguous_empty_array: An empty-array comparison blocks evaluation of a published Revision and prevents a Draft from being published because the original JSON shape cannot be confirmed.
diff.safety_unverified_array_shape: The original JSON shape of the array comparison cannot be verified, so evaluation of a published Revision and Draft publishing are blocked.
diff.safety_unverified_count: Array comparison conditions with unverified original shape: {count}
diff.safety_unknown_detail: The definition structure is incomplete, so its safety cannot be confirmed. Do not treat it as safe.
diff.safety_legacy_shape_limit: The stored legacy data cannot reveal whether the original input used an empty object ({}) or an empty list ([]).
diff.publishable: The current definition meets DSL and safety validation requirements.
diff.not_publishable: The current definition cannot be published.
diff.publishability_note: This status does not guarantee a successful publish. Permission, version conflicts, and storage state also affect the result.
diff.incomplete: The comparison is incomplete. Some changes may not be classified precisely.
diff.limitation_position: Valid unique rule IDs were unavailable, so rules were compared by position.
diff.limitation_order: Rule order changes could not be identified.
diff.limitation_fields: Field structures were compared as whole values rather than individual entries.
diff.limitation_rules: Rule structures were compared as whole values rather than individual entries.
diff.forbidden: You do not have permission to read this policy.
diff.revision_not_found: The requested revision was not found.
diff.draft_not_found: The policy draft was not found.
diff.published_revision_not_found: The published revision was not found.
diff.invalid_selector: The comparison source selection is invalid.
diff.invalid_revision_version: Revision version must be a positive integer.
diff.definition_uncomparable: The policy definition cannot be compared.
diff.encoding_failed: The comparison result could not be generated safely.
diff.schema_not_ready: The storage schema is not ready, so comparison is unavailable.
diff.result_too_large: The comparison result exceeds the supported size.
diff.network_failed: Could not connect to the server. Try again.
diff.failed: Policy definitions could not be compared.

simulator.description: Evaluate the published revision through the real contract and record the result history.

simulator.policy_search: Search policy key or owner extension
simulator.policies_load_failed: Published policies could not be loaded.
simulator.no_published_policies: There are no published policies available for evaluation.
simulator.action_hint: Action is an evaluation input separate from the policy key.
simulator.subject: Subject JSON
simulator.run_requires_valid_json: Check the syntax of all three JSON inputs.
